name: Honeypot Intel - Cowrie Session -> VT -> LLM MITRE ATT&CK -> Block IP -> Discord/Slack

nodes.name: 3b. VirusTotal - Downloaded File/URL
nodes.notes: Looks up the first downloaded file hash. For URLs, submit/look up via /urls with the URL id (base64url without padding) - hash lookup covers most bot payloads since Cowrie already hashes downloads.

nodes.name: 5. LLM - MITRE Session Analysis
nodes.notes: Full prompt + ATT&CK mapping rules: ../../prompts/llm-mitre-session-analysis.md - swap model/provider freely, keep JSON-only output and a fast small model.

parameters.jsonBody: ={ "model": "gpt-4o-mini", "temperature": 0.1, "response_format": { "type": "json_object" }, "messages": [ { "role": "system", "content": "You are a threat-intel analyst reviewing a Cowrie honeypot session. Respond ONLY with valid JSON: {summary, attacker_goal, mitre: [{tactic, technique, id}], iocs: {ips, urls, hashes, credentials_tried}, is_bot, severity: low|medium|high|critical, confidence: 0-100, recommended_action: monitor|block_ip|escalate_human}. Map ONLY techniques the commands evidence (brute force T1110.001, discovery T1082/T1033, ingress tool transfer T1105, execution T1059.004, resource hijacking T1496). Any payload download or execution = high/critical + block_ip. Login-only spraying = low/medium + monitor unless VT strongly malicious. Never invent commands, URLs or hashes." }, { "role": "user", "content": "Session: " + JSON.stringify($json.session) + " VirusTotal IP: " + JSON.stringify($json.virustotal_ip) + " VirusTotal files: " + JSON.stringify($json.virustotal_files) } ] }

nodes.name: 6. Decision Gate - Block?
nodes.notes: DETERMINISTIC gate - the LLM never blocks by itself (log content is attacker-controlled = prompt injection surface). Block iff: VT IP malicious >= 5, OR VT file malicious >= 3, OR the session really downloaded/executed a payload AND LLM confidence >= 70.

nodes.name: 8a. AWS Lambda - Block IP (NACL/WAF)
nodes.notes: SGs cannot DENY - this Lambda inserts a NACL deny rule and updates the WAF IP set. Requires n8n AWS creds scoped ONLY to lambda:InvokeFunction on this Lambda. See ../../lambda/block_ip.py

nodes.name: 8b. Notify - Discord/Slack (detailed)
nodes.notes: For Slack: replace the Discord embed body with Slack blocks using the same fields. Fires on BOTH branches so analysts also see monitor-only sessions (with action = analysis.recommended_action).

parameters.jsonBody: ={ "content": "🍯 **HONEYPOT SESSION ANALYZED**", "embeds": [{ "title": "[" + $json.analysis.severity.toUpperCase() + "] " + ($json.analysis.attacker_goal || 'unknown goal') + " from " + $json.session.source_ip, "description": $json.analysis.summary, "color": $json.analysis.severity === 'critical' ? 15158332 : $json.analysis.severity === 'high' ? 15105570 : 3447003, "fields": [ {"name":"Attacker IP","value": String($json.session.source_ip) + " (" + ($json.virustotal_ip.country || '?') + ", " + ($json.virustotal_ip.as_owner || '?') + ")", "inline": true}, {"name":"VirusTotal","value": "IP malicious: " + $json.virustotal_ip.malicious + " | File malicious: " + $json.virustotal_files.malicious, "inline": true}, {"name":"Session","value": $json.session.session_id + " - " + (($json.session.event.commands || []).length) + " commands, " + (($json.session.event.downloads || []).length) + " downloads", "inline": true}, {"name":"Top commands","value": "```" + (($json.session.event.commands || []).slice(0, 8).join('\n') || 'none') + "```"}, {"name":"MITRE ATT&CK","value": (($json.analysis.mitre || []).map(function(m){ return m.id + ' ' + m.technique; }).join('\n') || 'none mapped')}, {"name":"Action taken","value": $json.should_block ? '⛔ IP BLOCKED (NACL deny + WAF IP set)' : $json.analysis.recommended_action, "inline": true}, {"name":"LLM confidence","value": String($json.analysis.confidence) + '%', "inline": true} ] }] }
